[block:html]
{
  "html": "<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  <title>Page not found</title>\n  <style>\n    :root {\n      --background: #ffffff;\n      --foreground: #252525;\n      --card: #ffffff;\n      --card-foreground: #252525;\n      --muted: #ececf0;\n      --muted-foreground: #717182;\n      --accent: #e9ebef;\n      --accent-foreground: #030213;\n      --border: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n      --brand: #06BCD4;\n      --brand-tab: #00BCD4;\n      --radius: 0.625rem;\n      --radius-md: calc(var(--radius) - 2px);\n    }\n\n    * { box-sizing: border-box; }\n    html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }\n    body {\n      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, \"Helvetica Neue\", Arial, sans-serif;\n      font-size: 16px;\n      line-height: 1.5;\n      color: var(--foreground);\n      background: var(--background);\n      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;\n    }\n\n    .page { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh; background: var(--background); }\n    .container { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1rem; width: 100%; }\n\n    /* Main */\n    main {\n      flex: 1;\n      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;\n      padding: 4rem 1rem;\n    }\n    .content { max-width: 42rem; width: 100%; }\n    .intro { margin-bottom: 3rem; }\n    h1 {\n      font-size: 1.5rem;\n      font-weight: 500;\n      line-height: 1.5;\n      margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;\n    }\n    h3 {\n      font-size: 1.125rem;\n      font-weight: 500;\n      line-height: 1.5;\n      margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;\n    }\n    .lead {\n      color: var(--muted-foreground);\n      max-width: 36rem;\n      line-height: 1.625;\n      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;\n    }\n    .lead.last { margin-bottom: 2rem; }\n    .lead a {\n      color: var(--brand);\n      font-weight: 500;\n      text-decoration: none;\n    }\n    .lead a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }\n\n    .recommendations { padding-top: 2rem; }\n    .illustration {\n      display: block;\n      width: 100%;\n      max-width: 1000px;\n      height: auto;\n      margin: 0 0 2rem 0;\n    }\n\n    .related-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }\n    .related-link {\n      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;\n      padding: 1rem;\n      border: 1px solid var(--border);\n      border-radius: var(--radius-md);\n      background: var(--card);\n      color: var(--card-foreground);\n      text-decoration: none;\n      transition: background-color 0.15s ease;\n    }\n    .related-link:hover { background: rgba(233, 235, 239, 0.5); }\n    .related-link .chevron {\n      width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem;\n      color: var(--muted-foreground);\n      transition: transform 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;\n      flex-shrink: 0;\n    }\n    .related-link:hover .chevron {\n      color: var(--accent-foreground);\n      transform: translateX(0.25rem);\n    }\n\n    }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n  <div class=\"page\">\n\n    <main>\n      <div class=\"content\">\n        <section class=\"intro\">\n          <h1>Page not found</h1>\n          <p class=\"lead\">This page is unavailable&#8212;it&#8217;s been moved, renamed, or the link is incorrect.</p>\n          <p class=\"lead last\">Use the search bar above or go to the <a href=\"https://documentation.bloomreach.com/\">documentation homepage</a>.</p>\n        </section>\n\n        <section class=\"recommendations\" aria-labelledby=\"related-heading\">\n          <img class=\"illustration\" alt=\"\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\">\n          <h3 id=\"related-heading\">Browse similar pages</h3>\n          <div class=\"related-list\">\n          </div>\n        </section>\n      </div>\n    </main>\n\n  </div>\n\n  <!-- Local-preview only: in ReadMe, delete this line and paste related-pages.js into Custom JS. -->\n  <script src=\"/related-pages.js\" defer></script>\n</body>\n</html>\n"
}
[/block]


[block:html]
{
  "html": "(async () => {\n  // Only run on 404 pages\n  if (!document.title.startsWith('404')) return\n\n  const levenshtein = (a,b) => {\n    if (a.length < b.length) [a,b] = [b,a]\n    const row = [...Array(b.length + 1).keys()]\n    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {\n      let prev = i + 1\n      for (let j = 0; j < b.length; j++) {\n        const val = Math.min(\n          row[j + 1] + 1,\n          prev + 1,\n          row[j] + (a[i] !== b[j])\n        )\n        row[j] = prev\n        prev = val\n      }\n      row[b.length] = prev\n    }\n    return row[b.length]\n  }\n\n  const header = document.querySelector('.HeaderStyle')\n  if (!header) return\n\n  const current = location.href\n  const sitemapUrl = `${location.origin}/sitemap.xml`\n\n  const xml = await fetch(sitemapUrl).then(r => r.text())\n  const locs = [...xml.matchAll(/<loc>(.*?)<\\/loc>/g)].map(m => m[1])\n\n  const closest = locs\n    .filter(u => u !== current)\n    .map(u => ({\n      url: u,\n      distance: levenshtein(current, u)\n    }))\n    .sort((a,b) => a.distance - b.distance)\n    .slice(0, 3)\n\n  if (!closest.length) return\n\n  const suggestions = document.createElement('div')\n  suggestions.innerHTML = `\n    <h3>Did you mean:</h3>\n    <ul>\n      ${closest.map(c => `<li><a href=\"${c.url}\">${c.url}</a></li>`).join('')}\n    </ul>\n  `\n\n  header.appendChild(suggestions)\n})()"
}
[/block]
